deck_title: Lorentz-Lorenz local-field polarizability vs naive uncoupled dipole susceptibility rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Hendrik Antoon Lorentz (1880), Ludvig Valentin Lorenz (1880), Rudolf Clausius (1879) & Ottaviano-Fabrizio Mossotti (1850) local-field dielectric polarizability law ((n^2 - 1)/(n^2 + 2) = y = N*alpha/(3*eps_0) = u/(1+u), accounting for the Lorentz spherical cavity local field E_loc = E/(1 - y) so optical electric susceptibility chi = n^2 - 1 = 3y/(1 - y) locks at chi/chi_exact = 1.0000x across all 17 density stations u in [0.0000, 1.0000] with 0/17 deficient stations) versus naive dilute-gas uncoupled dipole susceptibility (chi_naive = 3y, which omits dipole-dipole cavity feedback and underestimates true susceptibility by 1/(1 - y) = 1 + u up to 1.2500x at u=0.25, 1.5000x at u=0.50, and 2.0000x at y=0.50 u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-order dipole-cavity Neumann series.
